Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7974); Sala (i.e. Shelach), a patriarch:--Sala.
BiblicalUsage: Sala is a patriarch in the line from Shem to Abraham. You find the name in Luke 3:32, "Which was of Jesse, which was of Obed…", and again in Luke 3:35.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Sala counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
